title: Getting to the caverns
summary: Buy the Forgotten Tower map, take the key from the tower, and use it on Cracked Bedrock.

steps.title: Buy the Forgotten Tower map
steps.body: Trade with an Expert Cartographer in the Overworld for an explorer map to a nearby Illager tower.

steps.title: Defeat the Illagers and claim the key
steps.body: Follow the map to the tower, defeat the Illagers, and loot the Key to the Caverns from the top chest.

steps.title: Dig down to bedrock
steps.body: Mine down to the Overworld bedrock floor and look for Cracked Bedrock. Small veins appear throughout the bottom bedrock layer.

steps.title: Open the gateway
steps.body: Use the Key on Cracked Bedrock to replace that block with a permanent gateway, then step onto it.
steps.note: The return gateway is in the Dark Caverns ceiling. Follow the lights down the enclosed ladder shaft. To return, jump into the gateway overhead.
